SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Chin. s.]
Pressure in pit of stomach up into throat, and pressure in stomach, < after drinking water. θ Cholera.
After eating, pressure in stomach, followed by cutting in upper and middle abdominal region.
Even the slightest food causes pressure in stomach and a return of the usual symptoms.
Pain in epigastrium, < by pressure.
Swelling and sensitiveness of epigastrium.
Dyspepsia or cardialgia, with nausea, loathing of food, bitter eructations, bitter taste in mouth, vomiting of bile, oppression of stomach, heartburn or burning in stomach and œsophagus, and feeling of constriction and pulling sensation in stomach.
Severe cardialgia.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Chin. s.]
Pain in region of liver, shortly before going to bed.
Severe pain in left hypochondrium, with shaking chill.
Pain in region of liver and spleen, on bending, taking a deep breath, or coughing. θ Intermittent.
Painful enlargement of spleen after intermittent.
Enlargement of spleen with dropsy.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Chin. s.]
Pain in bowels, especially after eating. θ Cholera.
Griping and tearing in abdomen, extending to chest, with pressing towards groin during menses. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Flatulent colic of an intermittent type.
Abdomen distended. θ Typhus. θ Variola.
Visceral obstructions, especially engorgement of spleen and liver.
Cecal region distended, gurgling on pressure. θ Typhus.
Relaxed condition of digestive organs of old people, under the form of dyspepsia.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Chin. s.]
Nightly diarrhœa.
Diarrhœa ; stools watery, slimy, dark, or even blackish, having an offensive smell.
Constipation or soft stools followed by weakness.
Involuntary diarrheic stools. θ Typhus.
Stool hard, resembling sheep dung.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Chin. s.]
Burning in urethra during urination.
The urine soon becomes turbid, with slimy flocks and a clay-colored, greasy sediment.
Urine fatty and deposits a straw-yellow, brick-dust sediment.
Involuntary urination. θ Typhus.
Diabetes.
Albuminuria. θ Puerperal convulsions.
Phosphates increased.
Urine loaded with lithates. θ Supraorbital neuralgia.
Hæmaturia.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Chin. s.]
Menses too early and too profuse.
Violent uterine contractions sufficient to produce abortion.
Profuse menstruation followed by headache, with nausea, chilliness, cold feet and prostration.
Passive metrorrhagias, with diminished irritability.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Chin. s.]
Two weeks after confinement, in consequence of fright, violent uterine neuralgia, returning at same hour every afternoon, accompanied by dyspnœa, small pulse, and clammy sweat on extremities, uterine region sensitive to touch.
The labor pains appear like tonic spasms, and are accompanied by convulsive twitches, unconsciousness after parturition, tetanic convulsions, in intervals convulsive action of muscles of face, eyes, etc. ; want of consciousness, oppressed respiration, distended veins on head and neck, weak, rapid and intermitting pulse, and albuminuria.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Chin. s.]
Intermittent aphonia.
More or less complete loss of voice, about 4 P. M. ; preceded by thirst, cough, constriction of neck, headache or neuralgia ; heat in head and frequent pulse.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Chin. s.]
Can scarcely breathe from weakness. θ Intermittent.
Respirations 28. θ Variola.
Oppressed respiration. θ Puerperal convulsions.
Painful sense of pressure and weight on chest. θ Spinal irritation.
Anxiety and dyspnœa with intercostal pain. θ Typhus.
Respiration very much accelerated, abnormal rising and falling of thorax. θ Spinal irritation.
Respiration slow and irregular.
   

COUGH. [27] [Chin. s.]
Troublesome, moist cough. θ Variola.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Chin. s.]
Oppression of chest.
Stitches in left side, below short ribs.
Lancinations in right half of chest, extending towards shoulder, arresting breathing, > by bending trunk forward.
Rattling of phlegm through entire right side of chest. θ Typhus.
Hemorrhage from lungs ; with diarrhœa, fever, cold sweat and prostration.
Pain in chest during chill.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Chin. s.]
Weak, rapid and intermitting pulse. θ Puerperal convulsions.
Pulse 100, very small, heartbeat not perceptible, sounds scarcely audible. θ Spinal irritation.
Pulse 120. θ Variola.
Palpitation from a little exercise.
Angina pectoris with marasmus.
Pulse : accelerated ; large ; full during chill and heat, weak and trembling at close of paroxysm, from fifty to sixty per minute ; slow, particularly after eating ; full or small, but weak and slow ; frequent during heat.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Chin. s.]
Stinging, tearing pain in intercostal space, between eighth and ninth ribs, right side, extending from spine to sternum, sensitive to pressure, < from 4 to 7 P. M., produces anxiety and dyspnœa. θ Typhus.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Chin. s.]
Every day at about 4 P. M. violent pain in lateral muscles of neck, which appear to him to be swollen and contracted, his head is giddy and heavy, and he wants to lie down. θ Periodical cervical neuralgia.
Sensitiveness of last cervical and first dorsal vertebræ to pressure.
Spine painful on pressure in all stages of fever paroxysm.
Three upper dorsal vertebræ are sensitive and painful to touch ; pressure causes dyspnœa. θ Spinal irritation.
Periodical pain in back, returning about midnight and extending into head. θ Spinal irritation.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Chin. s.]
Rheumatism of right shoulder.
Hands cold and cold sweat.
